Rule by rule against the pre-trim text: ownership kept; "answered another way" kept as "another answer"; "made moot" restored and widened to "once anything makes it needless", with "work dropped" named as the case round 5 showed was uninstructed; "a later write names that is no longer needed" kept as "a later write"; the retraction kept. proof.negativeControl: the word arithmetic is the control in both directions: the round-5 head stood at 1,998 with the rule missing, and the pre-trim head at 2,016 with the rule present and the guard red. proof.command: go build -o rigtest/envoy-listener-r6 ./cmd/listener; run it with PORT=9040 NATS_URLS=nats://127.0.0.1:4434 NATS_NKEY_SEED_FILE=out-denied/dispatch.seed; curl -i -X POST /v1/messages/publish for notifications.dispatch.issue.R6-1.comment.created; match the body against the constant read out of packages/daemon/internal/notify/notify.go; bun run publish-denied.ts http://127.0.0.1:9040
